name: enrich-contact-records
description: Enrich Notion contact records with a work email and profile signals. HarvestAPI first when the contact has a LinkedIn URL: a synchronous find_profile lookup by that URL returns name, title, about (Bio), city, country and an SMTP-checked address (written only when deliverable + valid). BetterContact is the fallback when HarvestAPI is not tried (no LinkedIn URL), finds nothing, errors, or finds the profile but no deliverable address — in that last case HarvestAPI's profile is kept and only the address comes from BetterContact. BetterContact is an async waterfall job: the durable submits it with its own ctx.createCallback URL as the webhook, parks, and resumes when BetterContact posts the terminated result (polling get_contact is the fallback, incl. the on_hold out-of-credits state); it needs first + last name and a company domain (Company rollup, else the corporate Primary Email host) and writes only deliverable / catch_all_safe addresses. An enriched email is written only when corroborated against something the CRM already holds — a shared address, the contact's LinkedIn profile, the known company domain, or the lookup being keyed on the contact's own LinkedIn URL (HarvestAPI) or own domain + name (BetterContact); an uncorroborated or unverified address is named in the outcome comment and written nowhere. A corroborated work address takes Primary Email when the existing Primary is a consumer mailbox; a corporate Primary is left alone. LinkedIn display names never overwrite a name the contact already has. Empty webhook pings are skipped without raising.
enrichment_note: HarvestAPI (App242893CLIAPI find_profile, since 2026-10-07) is tried first whenever the Linkedin property is set; ~17s synchronous; an unknown URL returns an empty data array. Its photo is NOT used (Path C stays removed). BetterContact returns no bio, no photo and rarely a job title, so a BetterContact-only run leaves Bio as it is. Callback timeout 600s, then 5 polls 60s apart. The callback URL host is code-substrate-runner.zapier.com (not the SDK default); verified live 2026-09-18.
